scope_of_deliverables.value: The British Columbia Energy Regulator (BCER) is seeking services to design and implement a replacement for its existing Oracle APEX-based CSV download functionality. Under the “Scope of Services” section, the solution is to integrate with TIBCO Data Virtualization web services, retrieve datasets in JSON and XML formats, and allow dynamic export to structured formats such as CSV and Excel.
scope_of_deliverables.quote:
Scope of Services

The selected Proponent will work with BCER’s Digital Services and Data Platform teams to design and implement a replacement for the existing Oracle APEX-based CSV download functionality.  The new solution will integrate with TIBCO Data Virtualization (TDV) web services to retrieve datasets in JSON and XML formats and allow dynamic export into structured formats like CSV and Excel.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote:
Proposals not clearly demonstrating that they meet the following mandatory criteria will be excluded from further consideration during the evaluation process:

• The Proposal must be received before the designated closing date and time.
• The Proposal must be in English and submitted electronically to https://procurement.bc-er.ca/
• The Proponent must confirm that any personal information received, collected or held over the course of the review will be stored and used only in Canada.
• The Proposal must contain an independence and objectivity statement confirming the Proponent is free of any actual or perceived conflict of interest and free of bias with respect to the BCER, its officers and employees.

Failure to meet all mandatory criteria above will disqualify the Proponent’s Proposal from further review.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
Proposals meeting all the mandatory criteria
will be further assessed against the desirable criteria.

Desirable Criteria Weight
Proponent’s Corporate Location 5%
• Preference may be given to vendors with a presence in British Columbia
Proponent’s Qualifications 10%
• Demonstrated expertise in web service integration and data transformation
• Strong development and documentation capabilities
• Relevant technical certifications (e.g., API development, Data Virtualization)
Proponent’s Relevant Experience 50%
• Experience with TIBCO Data Virtualization, similar data virtualization platforms or
extensive experience with REST and SOAP webservices.
• Demonstrated skill in transforming JSON/XML into CSV/Excel formats
• Familiarity with public data portals and public sector digital service delivery
• Experience delivering secure, public facing webservices for data sharing
Proposed Approach and Resource Availability 20%
• Clear and practical approach to delivering scope of services
• Understanding of data governance principles and best practices
• Confirmation of availability and ability to meet timelines
Pricing 15%
• Total cost in CAD, including hourly rates and estimated effort
• Cost-effectiveness relative to proposed value and deliverables
• Transparency and clarity of pricing structure

vendor_demonstration_required.quote:
The top ranking (to a maximum of three) Proponents may be asked to attend an interview with the evaluation team. During the interview, the evaluation committee may clarify and/or verify statements made in the written Response.

The requirement for interviews is optional. The BCER reserves the right to complete the evaluation process without Proponent interviews. Interview scoring criteria will be shared with interviewees prior to an interview if they are scheduled.
